name: starci-skills
description: Executable checks for the StarCi skills trust tree.

scripts.test:skill-runtime: node --test scripts/build-skill-catalog.spec.mjs scripts/evaluate-skill-routing.spec.mjs scripts/validate-skill-facades.spec.mjs && python -m unittest discover -s runtime/design-runtime/tests -v
scripts.check:skill-runtime: node scripts/build-skill-catalog.mjs --check && node scripts/evaluate-skill-routing.mjs --check && node scripts/validate-skill-facades.mjs && python scripts/design-knowledge-query.py build && python scripts/design-knowledge-query.py status
